svg.title: Rotating and uniformly refitting a fire perimeter
svg.desc: An irregular fire perimeter rotates between minus thirty and thirty degrees. At every angle it is uniformly scaled and centered inside a 128 by 72 pixel canvas with a two-pixel map margin. The bounds change from width-limited to height-limited while the same map retains its proportions. Three permanent views at minus thirty, zero and thirty degrees show different fits without animation. This illustrates candidate fitting only, not dart rasterization, scoring or search order.
svg.text: Rotating changes the available uniform scale
The same fire perimeter stays centered and fits the two-pixel margin.
One dimension reaches the margin; equal x/y scale preserves the fire's proportions.
Projected units are illustrative. Dart scoring and search selection are shown separately.
